allocation.extra_nonprimary_opponents: May be recorded diagnostically but are not substituted silently for missing primary quotas in the primary named-opponent gate.
allocation.opponent_field_semantics: Ledger field 'opponent' stores the canonical two-opponent stack label for primary gate games.
allocation.rule: At each look, distribute each arm as evenly as integer arithmetic permits across opponent-stack x SkatAI-seat strata.
allocation.runtime_priority: Prefer the arm with fewer scored games, then the most underfilled target opponent-stack x seat stratum.
